prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice with your companion while you wait", "Try feeding and petting your companion preview while generation finishes in the background."]
1: ["Continue to Controls Guide", "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Left-click to interact, drag to reposition on screen, or right-click the tray icon to hide or open settings.", "Left-click: Interact, Drag: Move pet, Right-click tray: Hide/Settings"]
2: ["Follow the lighting and pose tips to ensure best rendering quality.", "Tips for the best pet render", "Use clear, well-lit photos showing your pet's face front-on without obstructions.", "Bright lighting, Clear face focus, Only one pet in picture"]
3: ["Select how you would like to create your desktop companion."]
4: ["Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync companion memory safely across launches."]
5: ["High contrast photos lead to clearer desktop pet animations."]
6: []
7: ["Look for your pet's icon in the system tray near your desktop clock to summon or hide your pet anytime."]
8: ["How would you like to meet your pet?", "Pick a ready-made loyal friend or upload photos to bring your real-life pet onto your desktop."]
9: ["Signing in secures your pet's memory so your friend is never lost.", "Cloud Save Active"]
